features.title: Everything you need to
features.subtitle: Our platform combines cutting-edge AI technology with proven learning methods to make sign language accessible and fun for everyone.

aiHandRecognition.title: AI Hand Recognition
aiHandRecognition.description: Our advanced AI analyzes your hand movements in real-time, providing instant feedback to perfect your signs.

interactiveVideoLessons.title: Interactive Video Lessons
interactiveVideoLessons.description: Learn from native signers with bite-sized video lessons. Practice at your own pace with repeat playback.

gamifiedLeagues.title: Gamified Leagues
gamifiedLeagues.description: Compete in Bronze, Silver, and Gold leagues. Earn XP, climb rankings, and unlock exclusive rewards.

adaptiveLearning.title: Adaptive Learning
adaptiveLearning.description: Our smart system adapts to your learning style and pace, ensuring optimal retention and progress.

communityPractice.title: Community Practice
communityPractice.description: Connect with fellow learners for practice sessions. Challenge friends and learn together.

dailyChallenges.title: Daily Challenges
dailyChallenges.description: Complete daily quests to earn bonus XP and keep your streak alive. New challenges every day!

leagues.title: Climb the ranks,
leagues.subtitle: Compete with learners worldwide in our tiered league system. The more you practice, the higher you climb!

bronze.name: Bronze
bronze.tooltip: Everyone starts here. Learn the basics and build your foundation.

silver.name: Silver
silver.tooltip: Prove your dedication. Top 10 in Bronze advance to Silver weekly.

gold.name: Gold
gold.tooltip: The best of the best. Only top performers reach Gold status.

leagues.ctaPrompt: Ready to start your competitive journey?

testimonials.title: Loved by
testimonials.subtitle: Join thousands of happy learners who have transformed their communication skills with SignLingo.

items.name: Sarah Chen
items.quote: SignLingo transformed how I communicate with my deaf students. The AI feedback is incredibly accurate and helped me learn ASL in just 3 months!

items.name: Marcus Johnson
items.quote: My daughter was born deaf, and this app helped our whole family learn to sign together. The gamification keeps everyone motivated!

items.name: Emily Rodriguez
items.quote: As a nurse, being able to communicate in sign language has been invaluable. The bite-sized lessons fit perfectly into my busy schedule.

items.name: David Kim
items.quote: The leagues make learning so competitive and fun! I never thought I'd be this excited about learning a new language.

items.name: Lisa Thompson
items.quote: Even as a professional interpreter, I use SignLingo to practice and stay sharp. The community features are fantastic!
